Additional upstream dependency license texts are preserved alongside it:

- polygon-clipping-splaytree-LICENSE: splaytree 3.1.2, MIT, from the License section of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w8r/splay-tree/v3.1.2/Readme.md
- polygon-clipping-robust-predicates-LICENSE: robust-predicates 3.0.2, Unlicense, from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mourner/robust-predicates/v3.0.2/LICENSE
